description: Image Description: The image shows two laptop computers side by side on a green cutting mat. The laptop on the left is white and has a keyboard visible, with a screen displaying a desktop that features an orange sunset backdrop with silhouetted structures, possibly a bridge, and multiple icons scattered across the screen. The laptop on the right is black, with a screen displaying a blue desktop background with a faint circular pattern and a few icons. Both laptops appear to be MacBooks, as indicated by the branding visible
